# AWS CodeArtifact packages

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Store and serve packages through repository endpoints for one package format.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] Publish and fetch npm packages through the repository endpoint
- [ ] Authorization token enforcement
- [ ] Upstream and external connection resolution
- [ ] `ListPackages`, `ListPackageVersions`, `DescribePackageVersion`
- [ ] Package groups
- [ ] `AWS::CodeArtifact::Domain` and `AWS::CodeArtifact::Repository`
